scenarios.name: Standard NDA inquiry — process and timeline
scenarios.persona: Procurement officer from a large bank
messages: Hi, this is Ravi from HDFC Bank procurement. We need to set up an NDA with Smallest AI.
What's your standard NDA process?
How long does it typically take?
Who would be the signatory from your side?
Great, we'll send our template to legal@smallest.ai. Thanks.

scenarios.name: MSA clause questions — liability and data
messages: Hi, I'm reviewing the MSA terms for Smallest AI. I have a few questions.
What's your standard position on liability caps?
And what about data processing? Do you use our data for training?
We need unlimited liability for data breaches. Is that possible?

scenarios.name: Vendor registration — what docs do you provide?
scenarios.persona: Vendor onboarding manager at Vodafone Idea
messages: Hello, we're onboarding Smallest AI as a vendor. What documents can you provide?
Do you have ISO certification?
We also need your GST and PAN details.
How quickly can you send all this?

scenarios.name: Caller asks about pricing (out of scope)
scenarios.persona: Confused procurement person asking legal desk about pricing
messages: Hi, I want to know your pricing per minute for voice AI.
Ok, then who handles NDA execution?

scenarios.name: Caller says legal is blocking their deal — urgent
messages: Hi, this is urgent. We've been waiting 3 weeks for NDA counter-signature from your side. The deal is stalled.
This is for TVS Credit.
We need it resolved today.

expectedBehaviors.description: Agent should identify the company before looking up status

scenarios.name: Indian bank asks about Aadhaar E-Sign
messages: We use Aadhaar-based E-Sign for all vendor NDAs. Can Smallest AI support that?
What signatory details do we need from your side for E-Sign?
